title: ESQL: Graceful handling of non-bool condition in the filter

timeline.message:
ESQL: Graceful handling of non-bool condition in the filter

Improve the Verifier to handle queries with non-boolean expressions
 used in the WHERE clause (where 10)
In the process improve the readability of the Verifier class by
 extracting the checks into their own methods

Fix #100049
timeline.author: Costin Leau

diff.patch:
@@ -76,3 +76,11 @@ emp_no:integer | first_name:keyword
 10010          |Duangkaew      
 10011          |Mary       
 ;
+
+
+whereNonBoolField
+from employees | where salary | keep salary | limit 3 | sort salary;
+
+salary:i
+0
+;
